name: Audio Leveler
author: G-Hancox
description: Makes every song in your show play at the same loudness. Measures each song in the music folder (EBU R128 LUFS and true peak) and levels it to a target you choose, with three leveling types: volume only, loudness match with a peak limiter, or light compression. File names and timing are kept, so sequences stay in sync. Originals are backed up for one-click restore, and work waits until no show is playing. Runs entirely on this device using ffmpeg.

privacy.summary: Runs on this device only. Rewrites the songs you choose to level and keeps backup copies of their originals.

collects.what: Backup copies of the songs you level, and their loudness measurements

systemChanges.what: Replaces songs in FPP's music folder with leveled versions when you press Level (same names; originals backed up unless you turn that off).
